1: 1 The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Hear this, ye old men, And give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, Or in the days of your fathers? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Tell ye your children of it, And let your children tell their children, And their children another generation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

That which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; And that which the locust hath left hath the canker-worm eaten; And that which the canker-worm hath left hath the caterpillar eaten. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Awake, ye drunkards, and weep, And wail, all ye drinkers of wine, Because of the sweet wine, For it is cut off from your mouth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For a people is come up upon my land,  ​ Mighty, and without number; His teeth are the teeth of a lion, And he hath the jaw-teeth of a lioness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath laid my vine waste, And blasted my fig-tree; He hath made it clean bare, and cast it down, The branches thereof are made white. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth For the husband of her youth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The meal-offering and the drink-offering is cut off From the house of the Lord ; The priests mourn, Even the Lord's ministers. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The field is wasted, The land mourneth; For the corn is wasted, The new wine is dried up, The oil languisheth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be ashamed, O ye husbandmen, Wail, O ye vinedressers, For the wheat and for the barley; Because the harvest of the field is perished. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The vine is withered, And the fig-tree languisheth; The pomegranate-tree, the palm-tree also, and the apple-tree, Even all the trees of the field are withered; For joy is withered away from the sons of men. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests, Wail, ye ministers of the altar; Come, lie all night in sackcloth, Ye ministers of my God, For the meal-offering and the drink-offering is withholden From the house of your God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sanctify ye a fast, Call a solemn assembly, Gather the elders And all the inhabitants of the land Unto the house of the Lord your God, And cry unto the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Alas for the day! For the day of the Lord is at hand, And as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Is not the food cut off Before our eyes, Yea, joy and gladness From the house of our God? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The grains shrivel under their hoes; The garners are laid desolate, The barns are broken down; For the corn is withered. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
How do the beasts groan! The herds of cattle are perplexed, Because they have no pasture; Yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Unto Thee, O Lord , do I cry, For the fire hath devoured The pastures of the wilderness, And the flame hath set ablaze All the trees of the field. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, the beasts of the field pant unto Thee; For the water brooks are dried up, And the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness. <span class="anchor"
2: 2 Blow ye the horn in Zion, And sound an alarm in My holy mountain; Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble; For the day of the Lord cometh, For it is at hand; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness, As blackness spread upon the mountains; A great people and a mighty,  ​ There hath not been ever the like, Neither shall be any more after them, Even to the years of many generations. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

A fire devoureth before them, And behind them a flame blazeth; The land is as the garden of Eden before them, And behind them a desolate wilderness; Yea, and nothing escapeth them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses, And as horsemen, so do they run. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Like the noise of chariots, On the tops of the mountains do they leap, Like the noise of a flame of fire That devoureth the stubble, As a mighty people set in battle array. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
At their presence the peoples are in anguish; All faces have gathered blackness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They run like mighty men, They climb the wall like men of war; And they move on every one in his ways, And they entangle not their paths. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Neither doth one thrust another, They march every one in his highway; And they break through the weapons, And suffer no harm <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They leap upon the city, They run upon the wall, They climb up into the houses; They enter in at the windows like a thief. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Before them the earth quaketh, The heavens tremble; The sun and the moon are become black, And the stars withdraw their shining. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And the Lord uttereth His voice before His army; For His camp is very great, For he is mighty that executeth His word; For great is the day of the LORD and very terrible; And who can abide it? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yet even now, saith the Lord , Turn ye unto Me with all your heart, And with fasting, and with weeping, and with lamentation; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And rend your heart, and not your garments, And turn unto the Lord your God; For He is gracious and compassionate, Long-suffering, and abundant in mercy, And repenteth Him of the evil. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who knoweth whether He will not turn and repent, And leave a blessing behind Him, Even a meal-offering and a drink-offering Unto the Lord your God? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Blow the horn in Zion, Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Gather the people, Sanctify the congregation, Assemble the elders, Gather the children, And those that suck the breasts; Let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber. And the bride out of her pavilion. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord , Weep between the porch and the altar, And let them say: 'Spare Thy people, O Lord ,  ​ And give not Thy heritage to reproach, That the nations should make them a byword. Wherefore should they say among the peoples. Where is their God?' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Then was the Lord jealous for His land, And had pity on His people. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And the Lord answered and said unto His people: 'Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, And ye shall be satisfied therewith; And I will no more make you a reproach among the nations; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

But I will remove far off from you the northern one, And will drive him into a land barren and desolate, With his face toward the eastern sea, And his hinder part toward the western sea; That his foulness may come up, and his ill savour may come up, Because he hath done great things.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Fear not, O land, be glad and rejoice; For the Lord hath done great things. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field; For the pastures of the wilderness do spring, For the tree beareth its fruit, The fig-tree and the vine do yield their strength. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice In the Lord your God; For He giveth you the former rain in just measure, And He causeth to come down for you the rain, The former rain and the latter rain, at the first. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And the floors shall be full of corn, And the vats shall overflow with wine and oil. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, The canker-worm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer-worm, My great army which I sent among you. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, And shall praise the name of the Lord your God, That hath dealt wondrously with you; And My people shall never be ashamed. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, And that I am the Lord your God, and there is none else; And My people shall never be ashamed. <span class="anchor"
3: 3 And it shall come to pass afterward, That I will pour out My spirit upon all flesh; And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your old men shall dream dreams, Your young men shall see visions; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids In those days will I pour out My spirit. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth, Blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the great and terrible day of the Lord come. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered;  ​ For in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those that escape, As the Lord hath said, And among the remnant those whom the Lord shall call. <span class="anchor"
4: 4 For, behold, in those days, and in that time, When I shall bring back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

I will gather all nations, And will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; And I will enter into judgment with them there For My people and for My heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations, And divided My land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And they have cast lots for My people; And have given a boy for a harlot, And sold a girl for wine, and have drunk. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And also what are ye to Me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the regions of Philistia? will ye render retribution on My behalf? and if ye render retribution on My behalf, swiftly, speedily will I return your retribution upon your own head. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
Forasmuch as ye have taken My silver and My gold, and have carried into your temples My goodly treasures; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
the children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the sons of the Jevanim, that ye might remove them far from their border; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
behold, I will stir them up out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your retribution upon your own head; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and; they shall sell them to the men of Sheba, to a nation far off; for the Lord hath spoken. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Proclaim ye this among the nations, Prepare war; Stir up the mighty men; Let all the men of war draw near, Let them come up. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Beat your plowshares into swords, And your pruning-hooks into spears; Let the weak say: 'I am strong.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Haste ye, and come, all ye nations round about, And gather yourselves together; Thither cause Thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord ! <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the nations be stirred up, and come up To the valley of Jehoshaphat; For there will I sit to judge All the nations round about. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Put ye in the sickle, For the harvest is ripe; Come, tread ye, For the winepress is full, the vats overflow; For their wickedness is great. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The sun and the moon are become black, And the stars withdraw their shining. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And the Lord shall roar from Zion, And utter His voice from Jerusalem, And the heavens and the earth shall shake; But the Lord will be a refuge unto His people, And a stronghold to the children of Israel.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God, Dwelling in Zion My holy mountain; Then shall Jerusalem be holy, And there shall no strangers pass through her any more. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And it shall come to pass in that day, That the mountains shall drop down sweet wine, And the hills shall flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah shall flow with waters; And a fountain shall come forth of the house of the Lord , And shall water the valley of Shittim. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Egypt shall be a desolation, And Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, For the violence against the children of Judah, Because they have shed innocent blood in their land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But Judah shall be inhabited for ever, And Jerusalem from generation to generation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And I will hold as innocent their blood that I have not held as innocent; And the Lord dwelleth in Zion.   ↑ That is, The Lord judgeth .
